newsitem.title: USA: NYPA sees Indian Pt nuke at full output by weekend.
newsitem.headline: NYPA sees Indian Pt nuke at full output by weekend.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) said Thursday it expects its 965 megawatt (MW) Indian Point nuclear unit 3 to resume full production by this weekend after restarting the unit Wednesday.
"We'll be back to full power possibly Friday, definitely this weekend," said an onsite plant spokesman, adding the unit reached 50 percent power this morning.
The unit, along the Hudson River north of New York City, was originally shut January 18 to repair its feedwater heaters.
The utility decided to extend the outage to repair the unit's power-operated relief valves and to reseal the manway to a reactor coolant system.

The adjoining 975 MW Indian Point 2, operated by Consolidated Edison Co of New York, is expected to resume operation by early next week after being shut January 27 to correct problems that made a feedwater valve inoperable.
